service: Monitored website (the site whose address is held in CHECK_URL)
observed_operations: HTTP GET (the default method of fetch) to the address in CHECK_URL, redirects not followed, timeout CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS (default 5000 ms); a status from 200 to 399 is up, 400 and above is down, and a timeout or connection error is down
observed_access: Anonymous request: no authorization header, cookie, credential or sign-in step appears in the source. Whether the site answers without sign-in is not shown.
proposed_access: No fixed request, because the source shows no authentication. Once the website owner confirms: if the site asks for sign-in, request an approved identity or account for the use case, the application permissions it needs and a supported automated authentication or SSO where it applies; if the site answers without sign-in, no identity request is needed.
permissions_to_confirm: Whether the site requires sign-in; the permission the check needs is not shown by the source and must be confirmed with the website owner.
unknowns: runtime value of CHECK_URL (host and path); environment; whether the site requires sign-in; identity reference; permission; reuse of an existing CI identity: unconfirmed
